title: Business Formation
headline_read: New businesses are forming at a healthy clip.

indicators.title: Business Applications · year-over-year
indicators.context: How fast new business applications are growing versus a year ago (Census Business Formation Statistics — roughly half a million applications a month). Falling applications mean fading dynamism.
indicators.read: Business applications are growing 23.4% a year.

indicators.title: High-Propensity Applications · year-over-year
indicators.context: Growth in applications with characteristics that make them likely to become employer businesses — the quality signal inside the headline count.
indicators.read: High-propensity applications are growing 5.9% a year.

indicators.title: High-Propensity Share of Applications
indicators.context: What fraction of all business applications look likely to become employers — formation quality over time. It ran near half before the pandemic-era boom in solo ventures pushed it below a third.
indicators.read: The high-propensity share of applications is 26.2%, down 4.4 points from a year ago.
indicators.no_severity_reason: A descriptive level shown for context — neither a high nor a low reading is simply good or bad.
